description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - Merchant Shipping (Carriage of Charges and Oil Fuels) Regulations No. 07 of 2021
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971. It establishes new legal requirements for the carriage of cargoes and oil fuels, giving effect to international maritime conventions. The content focuses entirely on creating regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
